criterion_text: In isolated Agent runtime, duplicate/out-of-order events, recycled Session names, replaced Pane/workload and restart/re-enumeration cannot leak old instance activity or let a stale provider overwrite the current owner; failed observation remains unknown and terminal attach/input/resize continues to work.

verifiers.summary: Session Activity rejects stale incarnations, retried events and retired owners instead of leaking a level

evidence.value: exact SHA 0e167fd5f1229e47a8990c47fca150119925f7d5: duplicate and older source generations were refused; a report from a retired owner/workload generation was refused; a same-name recreated Session started with no inherited level; an unobserved Pane or capability was refused

verifiers.summary: Activity refresh is identity-fenced against the real Pane and leaves terminal attach/input/resize intact

evidence.value: exact SHA 0e167fd5f1229e47a8990c47fca150119925f7d5: a real tmux Session with a real PTY attach accepted input and a resize while Activity reconciled its Pane; a failing specialized probe produced unknown rather than the generic working claim; killing the Session removed its activity from the verified inventory
